plan.title: Adipose treated vs control DE adjusted for sex and age
plan.analytical_narrative: 12 adipose bulk RNA-seq samples (6 treated, 6 control), raw Salmon gene-level counts (12000 genes x 12 samples), unpaired, single batch, with sex and age recorded but NOT matched between groups. Because age differs systematically between groups, an unadjusted treated-vs-control test would confound the treatment effect with an age effect; sex is a categorical covariate that must also be controlled for. The plan follows the grounded DESeq2 procedure: QC on sample structure first (to catch any sample that does not cluster with its group and to see whether sex/age drive early PCs), minimal low-count pre-filtering, a design that carries sex and age as fixed-effect covariates alongside condition (~ sex + age + condition, condition releveled so 'control' is the reference), a Wald test with apeglm shrinkage of the condition coefficient, BH-adjusted independent filtering at alpha=0.05, an edgeR quasi-likelihood cross-check for robustness (reporting the intersection as high-confidence), and fgsea preranked enrichment on the Wald statistic against MSigDB Hallmark (primary) and Reactome (secondary), both staged locally for human. A final report step assembles fit diagnostics, the DE table (raw and shrunken LFC), the two-method overlap, enrichment tables with leading-edge genes, and a full reproducibility record.

DESeq2 design ~ sex + age + condition, explicit reference level

Reproducible DE + enrichment report with diagnostics
